value.name: Aspect is not a fixed property of linguistic expressions (ELM 4) dataset
value.description: Stimuli, trial-level judgments, annotations, and derived measures for White, Grimm, & Glass (2026): Experiment 1a (cloze, 120 participants), Experiment 1b (temporal-overlap proportion, 250), and Experiment 2 (pairwise similarity, 202) on event descriptions headed by 40 English verbs. Verb senses point into the PropBank and VerbNet records of the Layers repository.

entries.value: judgment set (one per participant per experiment condition)
